items.label: Quét Zone Spawn (Dear ImGui Native C++)
Quét Chuỗi RAM DinoSpawnEntries_
items.payload: PID=$(pidof com.studiowildcard.wardrumstudios.ark || pgrep -f ark || pgrep -f wildcard || pgrep -f studiowildcard); if [ -n "$PID" ]; then echo "[+] Đang quét RAM PID: $PID..."; grep -a -o 'DinoSpawnEntries_[A-Za-z0-9_]*' /proc/$PID/mem | sort -u 2>&1; else echo '[-] Không tìm thấy PID game ARK Mobile!'; fi

items.label: Lọc Riêng Khu Vực Bờ Biển (Beach)
items.payload: PID=$(pidof com.studiowildcard.wardrumstudios.ark || pgrep -f ark || pgrep -f wildcard || pgrep -f studiowildcard); if [ -n "$PID" ]; then grep -a -o 'DinoSpawnEntries_[A-Za-z0-9_]*' /proc/$PID/mem | grep -i Beach | sort -u 2>&1; else echo '[-] Không tìm thấy PID game ARK Mobile!'; fi

items.label: Soi Dino Đang Nhắm (APrimalDinoCharacter)
items.payload: PID=$(pidof com.studiowildcard.wardrumstudios.ark || pgrep -f ark || pgrep -f wildcard || pgrep -f studiowildcard); if [ -n "$PID" ]; then grep -a -o 'APrimalDinoCharacter_[A-Za-z0-9_]*' /proc/$PID/mem | head -n 15 2>&1; else echo '[-] Không tìm thấy PID game ARK Mobile!'; fi

items.label: Quét Tất Cả Creatures Trong Vùng
items.payload: PID=$(pidof com.studiowildcard.wardrumstudios.ark || pgrep -f ark || pgrep -f wildcard || pgrep -f studiowildcard); if [ -n "$PID" ]; then grep -a -o 'Dino_Character_BP_[A-Za-z0-9_]*' /proc/$PID/mem | sort -u | head -n 20 2>&1; else echo '[-] Không tìm thấy PID game ARK Mobile!'; fi
